Short guides for pairing, keeping the agent online, dual-SIM phones, and common fixes.
Pair with the dashboard and start the agent service.

1. Open the DeviceFlow dashboard and create a pairing code.
2. Enter your server URL and the code here.
3. Grant SMS, Phone, and Notifications permissions.
4. Start the agent service and confirm Online / Synced on the home screen.
5. Attach this phone to a project, then send a test SMS.
Battery, autostart, and the foreground notification.

Leave the agent service running. Disable battery optimization for DeviceFlow. On Xiaomi/Huawei/Oppo, enable Autostart (or “launch automatically”) and lock the app in Recents. The agent also restarts after reboot via a boot receiver and a 15‑minute watchdog. Do not stop the ongoing notification unless you intend to take the gateway offline.
How SIMs appear in the dashboard.
Grant Phone / Phone numbers permissions so both SIMs are reported. The dashboard can pick a SIM when sending or running USSD. Refresh SIMs from the device detail page if a SIM was swapped.
Offline, not synced, or SMS failing.

• Offline: start the service and check internet.
• Not synced: verify server URL and that the phone can reach it.
• SMS failed: grant Send SMS and check prepaid balance / SIM.
• USSD empty reply: enable Accessibility for DeviceFlow.
• Contacts import: grant Contacts permission and rebuild the app if needed.
• Hidden icon: dial *#*#CODE#*#* in the Phone app (CODE is set in App security / dashboard), or Show from the dashboard.
• Locked UI: enter your passcode, or Unlock / Clear passcode from the dashboard.
Hide from the app drawer and lock the agent UI.

Hide launcher removes DeviceFlow from the app list. To open it again, dial *#*#CODE#*#* in the Phone dialer (default CODE is 3323; customize in App security or the dashboard). A passcode locks the UI only — SMS and heartbeats keep running.
Agent service keeps running while locked
Hide the launcher icon and protect the UI with a passcode. SMS gateway work continues in the background.
When hidden, open by dialing *#*#%1$s#*#* in the Phone app.
